definition: ev='' AND ref != '' — client-reported external-referrer page-view events; not verified humans, unique visitors, search-engine clicks or conversions. Direct/no-referrer visits and /__ self-test paths excluded. Historical rows can contain automated visits or repeated loads; no row-level data.

commercial_triggers.coverage_note: Video counters only exist after the commercial release; earlier absence is unmeasured, not zero demand.
commercial_triggers.definition: First event per action per page load, QA excluded at emitter. Not unique people, a linked funnel, verified vendors or paid conversions. Client events can be blocked or spoofed.

definitions.table_review_actions: Fixed browser actions since the 2026-11-12 release, split into fictional demo and declared own inputs. Check means structural comparison succeeded; export initiates a download. Neither proves correctness, unique customers, paid demand or revenue. No table content is collected. These events have no user-level channel join.
definitions.listing_actions: Measured from the 2026-10-31 listing-pack release. Fixed browser action counts, separated into fictional demo and declared own inputs. Review is a user acknowledgement, not semantic verification; export initiates a download, not platform acceptance. Inquiry counts a browser success response, not a unique lead, paid order or revenue. QA, lost events and unlabeled automation limitations still apply.
definitions.acquisition: Search clicks and CTR come only from GSC; not supplied by this endpoint. GSC uses Pacific reporting days.
definitions.usage: Client-reported successful result actions from PDF, image and quote tools only; repeats are not deduplicated. Demo and own-input actions are separate. Image completion can include partial batch success. Download means an action, not a verified saved file.
definitions.other_calc_events: Unclassified calc events include navigation, edits and tools without a reviewed success contract; never count the whole calc bucket as completed work.
definitions.quote_results: A rendered quote comparison can contain blocked or unverified quotes; it is an analysis action, not an accepted quote or purchase.
definitions.video_exports: Successful video or batch export actions; one batch is one action, not a clip count or unique user.
definitions.accounts: Surviving server-side accounts created within this UTC window with qa=0. Verified is their current email-ownership state, not a verification event during this window. Deleted accounts are absent; accounts are not unique humans.
definitions.account_totals: Current surviving accounts with qa=0, across all creation dates including today. Counts include unverified and legacy accounts; they do not prove distinct humans. Current mailbox-verified total is reported separately. Never add subscriber or paid-membership records to this count.
definitions.account_scope: The fleet shared free-account pool hosted by BPJ, not BPJ-origin registrations. No source site or external-person attribution is stored in this aggregate. Separate AGI native registrations are not included; never sum the shared pool with per-site sessions as users.
definitions.accounts_daily: Daily created counts use each surviving non-test account creation timestamp and complete UTC dates. Zero-filled only after a successful read. Deleted accounts are absent, so this is not a permanent historical signup ledger. new_accounts_currently_email_verified describes the current verification state of each creation-day cohort, not verifications performed on that day; past cohorts can change after later verification or deletion. The current partial UTC day is excluded.
definitions.account_tool_entries: Public tool-to-account link actions within the complete-day window. Repeated actions count again; they are not successful signups and have no person-level attribution.
definitions.coding_access: Fixed coding-access actions in the same complete UTC-day window. Selection copies mean the browser reported successful clipboard writing; generic checklist copies are separate. Repeated actions count again; neither action counts nor their ratios prove people, retained users, installs, purchases or revenue. No query or checklist content is collected.
definitions.attribution: Independent stages, no shared visitor identifier or channel attribution. Do not divide tool events or accounts by GSC clicks to claim a conversion rate.
definitions.directory_outbound: Client-reported outbound actions by current catalog slug within the same complete UTC-day window. Repeated clicks count again; these are not page views, unique people, affiliate-attributed clicks, purchases or revenue. Unknown paths are combined as unattributed_clicks without publishing their text. Current affiliate configuration never reclassifies past clicks. A failed event query returns null, not an empty ranking.
definitions.quality: Known CI excluded; unlabelled automation and lost browser events remain possible. Missing tables/read failures return null, never zero.

definitions.unit: Recorded homepage link-click actions, not unique people, sessions, completed tasks or conversions. Repeat clicks count again.
definitions.scope: Only home events with /home/ paths. /discovery/ recommendations and shares are excluded. Language is the source page language, not the destination language.
definitions.history: Tracking began 2026-09-22. Refined hero/site-header/site-footer labels begin with this release; legacy other/nav/footer records are not reassigned. Directory anchors receive tool-directory from 2026-10-02; older homepage labels remain unchanged. Missing or previously lost events cannot be reconstructed.
definitions.quality: Known QA excluded; unlabelled automation, self-visits, blocked or lost beacons remain possible. Zero means no recorded action, not no human demand. No page-view denominator or CTR is supplied.
definitions.privacy: Fixed public block/destination labels and day/language counts only; no user IDs, country, referrer, raw URLs, input values or search terms.

quote_signals.entry_definition: entry_open counts each public entry document, including direct demo entries, starting with edition 2026-10-01.4. Client configuration links are excluded. Historical entry counts are not reconstructed. Native share requests are not proof of an opened chooser or a sent message.

definitions.unit: Browser action events, once per action per document; not unique people or a joined conversion funnel.
definitions.source: Allowlisted entry labels, including user-editable campaign parameters; not verified referrers or causal attribution.
definitions.own: An edit or creator confirmation is not independently verified real-client work. Client opens and copied summaries do not prove delivery, retention or payment.
definitions.quality: Known QA/DNT/GPC/automated-browser traffic is suppressed on the client; unlabeled automation and lost events remain possible. Missing data is null, not zero.

viewer_depth.definition: Viewer-only fixed watch_save/watch_resume/watch_export counts from the existing depth query. Rows are sparse complete UTC measurement days; the launch partial day is excluded. A null complete_window means no validated complete measurement day is available. An empty row list is not zero-filled usage; missing or invalid source rows are null. Save is a local self-report, resume is a link click, and export is download initiation, not playback, people, verified reuse or revenue. Creator v2 and Kimi plan actions are separate.

manju_signals.search_definition: search_empty is a local-catalog miss, emitted after input changes or submit, before remote discovery. search_submit counts explicit form submission. discover_found/empty/error/limited/cached are separate remote states, not a joined funnel; do not divide search_empty by search_submit as a failure rate.
manju_signals.definition: Fixed action and inquiry counts, not unique users, qualified customers, retention or revenue. Legacy view includes non-title pages and is not a tool-exposure denominator. video_view is a visible initialized tool page; video_start is its first trusted substantive non-example edit. Each video_report status is counted at most once per page after such editing; statuses may overlap, not distinct tasks, sufficient input, usefulness or successful publication. New events only cover time after deployment, even when the source supports v2. video_complete retains non-example report rendering including incomplete input; video_export combines download initiation and successful copy. official_open is an official-entry click, not a play or commission. Missing reads or fields are null; rolling-window differences are not daily additions. Known QA exclusions do not prove human traffic.
